A company called GoGoCar provides a service which allows users to call for a driver nearby to travel to a certain destination. The company uses three database tables, USER, DRIVER and ORDER to store information on users, drivers and orders from users respectively.
USER

Type
Description

UNAME
Character
Name of user
PHONE

Primary key: UID
DRIVER
Field name
Type
Description
DID
Character
Identity code of driver
DNAME
Character
Name of driver
PHONE
Character
Phone number of driver
Primary key: DID
ORDERS
Field name
Type
Description
UID
Character
Identity code of user
DID
Character
Identity code of driver
ODATE
Date
Date of order
Primary key: UID + DID + ODATE
(a)
When John makes a second order with the same driver on the same date, an entity integrity problem occurs. Why?(2 marks)
________________________________________________________________________________
________________________________________________________________________________
(b)
Modify the structure of ORDERS and write the schema to fix the problem in (a).  (2 marks)
________________________________________________________________________________
________________________________________________________________________________
[--Answer:
(a)

(b)
ORDERS(OID, UID, DID, ODATE)

or

Foreign key: UID, DID
--]

items.stem:
A greenhouse that uses soil moisture sensors to monitor the moisture levels in the soil in different greenhouse beds. The information of sensors is stored in table SENSOR, and the data collected is stored in table DATA.
SENSOR
Field name
Description
SID
Identity code of the moisture sensor
NAME
Name of the moisture sensor
LOCATION
The location of the moisture sensor
Primary key: SID
DATA
Field name
Description
SID
Identity code of the moisture sensor
RECTIME
The date and time when the sensor data was collected
MOISTURE
The soil moisture percentage
Primary key: SID+RECTIME
(a)
Will any integrity problem exist if multiple sensors share the same NAME and LOCATION in the SENSOR table? (2 marks)
________________________________________________________________________________
________________________________________________________________________________
(b)
The MOISTURE field in DATA only allows numbers to be inserted. What type of integrity does the data control maintain?(1 mark)
________________________________________________________________________________
(c)
Explain why it is not advisable to index all fields in DATA. (2 marks)
________________________________________________________________________________
________________________________________________________________________________
[--Answer:
(a) No, as SID is the primary key of the SENSOR, even if multiple sensors share the same NAME and LOCATION, no integrity problems will occur when they have different SIDs.
(b) Domain integrity
(c) It takes time for the DBMS to update and it takes storage space to store.
--]

--]
